data.body: INVESTIGATION: File now at 3583 lines (growth since filing at 1212 due to deep-tier, overlay, and standard-tier tests added). Extraction into test-ci-llm-review-runner-deep.sh and test-ci-llm-review-runner-overlays.sh is the recommended approach. The test helpers (_create_mock_curl, _create_mock_llm_api_call, _add_anthropic_llm_wrapper) and _snapshot_fail/_TEST_TMPDIRS infrastructure would need to move to a shared lib or be sourced from each file. Non-trivial to extract safely — track as follow-up.
